research_question: Does unusually weak or opposite contemporaneous price response relative to aggressive directional trade-flow effort contain repeatable information about subsequent BTCUSDT USD-M Futures price behavior?

data_lineage.effort_source: stored shadow record features.orderflow from EvidenceHunter V1.2.3
data_lineage.historical_path_source: Binance public USD-M Futures aggTrades archive
data_lineage.future_target_source: Binance public USD-M Futures aggTrades archive

timing_contract.why_decision_time_is_safe: features.timestamp is written when build_features creates the feature snapshot, after upstream state/orderflow has been read.
timing_contract.reason_exact_snapshot_timestamp_missing: orderflow_snapshot.json is overwritten; the shadow record stores orderflow_age_seconds but not the exact per-record orderflow snapshot timestamp or first/last trade IDs/times.
timing_contract.alignment_caveat: orderflow_age_seconds was measured when STATE was built, while features.timestamp is written later. Therefore features.timestamp - orderflow_age_seconds is slightly later than the true historical orderflow snapshot timestamp by the state-to-feature build lag. It must not be described as exact.

fixed_binning.purpose: describe the response surface without choosing a single best threshold

discovery_protocol.threshold_rule: No threshold discovered on this dataset may be promoted as confirmed. Any candidate threshold must be frozen under a new confirmation hypothesis_id.
discovery_protocol.horizon_rule: 5m, 15m and 30m are all Discovery diagnostics. The best-looking horizon may not be retroactively declared the future Confirmation primary.
dependence_controls: chronological greedy non-overlap sample separately for each 5m/15m/30m horizon
moving-block bootstrap or another pre-specified serial-dependence-aware interval estimator

confirmation_separation.candidate_rule_creation: only after 168h dataset closure + backfill + audit + Discovery

forbidden_actions: Do not modify the current production collector during the 168h dataset.
Do not modify the current schema/feature/outcome definitions mid-dataset.
Do not call the reconstructed historical effort-window endpoint exact.
Do not choose a best threshold or best horizon and call it OOS on the same dataset.
Do not use depth/regime filters to rescue a weak overall Discovery result.
Do not admit a trading signal from Discovery alone.
next_operational_gate: Wait for Wall-Clock Span >=168h AND Effective Observed Coverage >=168h, freeze the dataset, mature the final 30m horizon, prefetch all required archive days, complete backfill, require audit_order.py PASS, then run this Discovery protocol.
